# BrandVoice AI
*Your brand's voice. Ten tweets. One click.* Enter brand details, get a brand-voice analysis plus exactly 10 tweets generated by a real LLM (OpenAI by default).

## Features
Brand form (tones, reference posts, language, hashtag preference, 2 example presets), voice summary, 10 tweet cards with category/rationale/char count, copy one/all, download .txt/.json, regenerate (real new backend call), validation and error states, responsive + accessible UI.

## Architecture
React/Vite/TS/Tailwind SPA -> FastAPI `/api/generate` -> `prompt_builder` (system prompt + user data as JSON) -> `ai_service.call_provider` (OpenAI-compatible; swap this one function to change provider) -> `validators` (Pydantic, exactly 10, unique ids, near-duplicate check, char counts computed in code, one repair retry). The API key lives only on the backend. There is no fake fallback: with no key, the API returns a 503 setup message.

## Run locally
```bash
cd backend && python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env   # set OPENAI_API_KEY
uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
cd frontend && cp .env.example .env && npm install && npm run dev   # http://localhost:5173
```
## Environment variables
Backend: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_MODEL` (default gpt-4o-mini), `OPENAI_BASE_URL`, `FRONTEND_ORIGIN` (comma-separated allowed CORS origins). Frontend: `VITE_API_URL` (build-time backend URL).

## Tests
`cd backend && python -m pytest` (mocked provider; the live test runs only if `OPENAI_API_KEY` is set). `cd frontend && npm test`. Build: `npm run build`.

## Deployment
Backend (Render/Railway/Fly): root `backend`, build `pip install -r requirements.txt`, start `uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT`; set the env vars above, with `FRONTEND_ORIGIN` = your frontend URL. Check `/api/health`.
Frontend (Vercel/Netlify): root `frontend`, build `npm run build`, output `dist`, set `VITE_API_URL` to the backend URL.

## Known limitations
Analyzes only pasted text and never fetches live social accounts. Without reference posts the voice is inferred. No auth or rate limiting beyond request-size limits (add one before public launch). Non-English quality depends on the model.

## Security
Keys only in backend env; reference posts are treated as untrusted data; errors never expose stack traces; no user text is logged.
